about: Canvas modes (DESIGN 5.31), as every runtime does them. A vector drawing is kept as SVG text, one element on a line: the svg line with its viewBox (the canvas's units, 1000 x 1000 without them), each shape, then </svg>, every line ending in a newline. A shape is a drawing shape (conformance/drawing.json) with whole numbers: rect {x, y, width, height, color} is <rect ... fill>, line {x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width} is <line ... stroke stroke-width>, ellipse {x, y, rx, ry, color} is <ellipse cx cy rx ry fill>, path {points, color, width} is <polyline points="x,y x,y" fill="none" stroke stroke-width>, text {x, y, text, color, size} is <text x y fill font-size>, with &, <, > and " written as entities. A line the runtime does not read as one of these is the shape {op: "svg", text: line}, kept as it is. Empty text is an empty drawing. A number is rounded half away from zero. With snap and a grid, a place (x, y, x1, y1, x2, y2, each point) is rounded to the nearest multiple of the grid; sizes are kept. An action that changes nothing, or names no object or shape, is refused; a readonly canvas refuses every action. A stroke is the picture after it as an image field holds a new picture, {data: base64 of a PNG} (conformance/pictures.json), and is kept as it comes; one whose data is no picture (conformance/pictures.json) is refused, so the record never holds it. `selected` is what the action touched, as a table's chosen row is kept: the object's place in its list, or the shape's place in the drawing, both from 0; null for none.

svg.name: every shape
svg.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300">
<rect x="10" y="20" width="30" height="40" fill="#ff0000"/>
<line x1="0" y1="0" x2="10" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
<ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#00ff00"/>
<polyline points="0,0 10,10 20,0" fill="none" stroke="#0000ff" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="5" y="15" fill="#333333" font-size="12">a & "b" <c></text>
</svg>

svg.name: a line it does not read is kept
svg.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
<circle cx="5" cy="5" r="2"/>
<rect x="1" y="2" width="3" height="4" fill="red"/>
</svg>

read.name: empty text is an empty drawing

actions.name: an object moves without snap, rounded
an object put where it is changes nothing
a stroke is the picture after it
a stroke that is no picture is refused
a shape is added to an empty drawing, snapped
